'''Tanzu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] who was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], where he could be found selling [[Armor/Legends|armor]] to [[Sith Inquisitor]]s on [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Tanzu appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a PvP Ranked Gear vendor for the Sith Inquisitor class on Vaiken Spacedock.<ref name="TOR" /> He was later removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
